subject: History
description: Swami Vivekananda (1863-1902) — Ramakrishna's disciple, Chicago Parliament 1893, Ramakrishna Mission, Hindu philosophy, Indian renaissance.

questions.stem: Swami VIVEKANANDA delivered his FAMOUS SPEECH at the World's Parliament of Religions in:
questions.explanation: SWAMI VIVEKANANDA delivered his FAMOUS SPEECH on 11 SEPTEMBER 1893 at the WORLD'S PARLIAMENT OF RELIGIONS, held at the Art Institute of Chicago, USA, as part of the World's Columbian Exposition. OPENING: 'Sisters and Brothers of America!' — drew an immediate 2-MINUTE STANDING OVATION from ~7,000 people (he had not even started his speech yet!). KEY POINTS in his ADDRESS: (1) Introduced HINDUISM + Vedantic philosophy to the WEST. (2) Urged TOLERANCE + ACCEPTANCE of all religions; quoted from BHAGAVAD GITA, Upanishads. (3) Spoke of UNITY in DIVERSITY of religions. (4) Made INDIA shine on world stage. AFTERMATH: lecture tours across USA + UK (~3-4 years); founded VEDANTA SOCIETY of NEW YORK (1894), London (1895), and others. Returned to INDIA 1897 to massive public welcomes. RAMAKRISHNA MISSION founded by him on 1 MAY 1897 (Belur Math area). BIRTH: 12 JANUARY 1863 (Calcutta) — celebrated as NATIONAL YOUTH DAY in India since 1985. ORIGINAL NAME: NARENDRA NATH DATTA. DEATH: 4 JULY 1902 (Belur Math, age 39 — short life but immense impact). FAMOUS QUOTES: 'Arise, Awake, and stop not till the goal is reached.' 'You cannot believe in God until you believe in yourself.' UPSC angle: Indian Renaissance + 19th-century reform. PYQ FREQUENCY: Vivekananda's Chicago speech in UPSC, MPSC, SSC modern history 1-2× per cycle.

questions.stem: Swami Vivekananda was the most prominent disciple of:
questions.explanation: RAMAKRISHNA PARAMAHAMSA (1836-1886) — Bengali mystic + saint; Vivekananda's GURU. Lived at DAKSHINESWAR KALI TEMPLE (Calcutta), priest there. Practiced + experienced multiple religious paths (Hindu sects, Islam, Christianity) and concluded: 'YATA MAT, TATA PATH' ('As many faiths, so many paths to God') — championed UNIVERSAL RELIGIOUS HARMONY. Met young NARENDRA NATH DATTA (later VIVEKANANDA) in 1881 — became spiritual mentor. RAMAKRISHNA's wife: SARADA DEVI ('Holy Mother') — also revered. RAMAKRISHNA's TEACHINGS: simple, profound; emphasized DIRECT EXPERIENCE of GOD over dogma; UNIVERSAL TRUTH in all religions; serve mankind = serve God. KEY DISCIPLES: (1) VIVEKANANDA — most famous; carried teachings worldwide. (2) Brahmananda — first president of Ramakrishna Math. (3) Saradananda. (4) Other 'direct disciples'. RAMAKRISHNA MISSION (1897, founded by Vivekananda after Ramakrishna's death) — based on RK's teachings; emphasizes service to humanity ('Daridra Narayana' — service to poor as service to God). CONTRAST to other 19th-century reformers: (a) Ram Mohan Roy — Brahmo Samaj (monotheism, anti-idolatry; rationalist). (b) Dayananda Saraswati — Arya Samaj (back to Vedas; militant Hindu reform). (c) RAMAKRISHNA-VIVEKANANDA — emphasized UNIVERSALITY of religious experience; less iconoclastic, more synthetic. UPSC angle: BENGAL RENAISSANCE + comparative reform movements. PYQ FREQUENCY: Ramakrishna-Vivekananda link in UPSC, SSC 1× per cycle.

questions.stem: RAMAKRISHNA MISSION was founded by Vivekananda in:
questions.explanation: RAMAKRISHNA MISSION — founded by SWAMI VIVEKANANDA on 1 MAY 1897 at BELUR (near Calcutta). HEADQUARTERS: BELUR MATH (West Bengal) — sprawling complex on banks of Hooghly river; main temple opened 1938. ORGANIZATIONAL STRUCTURE: (1) RAMAKRISHNA MATH — monastic order (sanyasis). (2) RAMAKRISHNA MISSION — service organization; legally registered. KEY FIGURES: (a) RAMAKRISHNA — founder-inspiration. (b) VIVEKANANDA — formal founder, 1st president. (c) BRAHMANANDA — first elected president (1901-1922). (d) Many subsequent presidents. PHILOSOPHY: 'ATMANO MOKSHARTHAM JAGAD HITAYA CHA' — 'For one's own salvation + welfare of the world'. ACTIVITIES: (1) RELIEF WORK — disaster relief (floods, famines, earthquakes). (2) HOSPITALS + dispensaries (~25). (3) SCHOOLS + colleges (~200+). (4) Vocational training centers. (5) Spiritual + cultural events. (6) PUBLISHING — 'Prabuddha Bharata', 'Vedanta Kesari', 'Udbodhan'. SIZE today: ~250 centres globally; 1000s of monks. INDIAN STATE STATUS: in Bengal, RK Mission has CULTURAL+EDUCATIONAL significance — RAMAKRISHNA MISSION VIDYAMANDIRA (Belur), RAMAKRISHNA MISSION VIVEKANANDA UNIVERSITY (deemed univ., 2005). RAMAKRISHNA MISSION INSTITUTE OF CULTURE (Gol Park, Kolkata) — major library + cultural center. UPSC angle: socio-religious organizations + their educational impact. PYQ FREQUENCY: RK Mission founding in UPSC, MPSC 1× per cycle.

questions.stem: Swami Vivekananda's BIRTHDAY (12 January) is celebrated as:
questions.explanation: NATIONAL YOUTH DAY — observed on 12 JANUARY (Vivekananda's birth anniversary) since 1985, declared by GOVT OF INDIA (Rajiv Gandhi era). PURPOSE: inspire INDIAN YOUTH with Vivekananda's vision of: (a) Spiritual awakening + character building. (b) Service to society. (c) Self-reliance. (d) Patriotism. EVENTS: speeches, debates, youth-empowerment programs across India. INDIA's MAJOR NATIONAL OBSERVANCES (memorize for SSC, UPSC, GA): (1) NATIONAL YOUTH DAY — 12 January (Vivekananda). (2) ARMY DAY — 15 January (KM Cariappa, 1st Indian C-in-C). (3) REPUBLIC DAY — 26 January (Constitution adopted 1950). (4) INTERNATIONAL WOMEN's DAY — 8 March. (5) NATIONAL SCIENCE DAY — 28 February (Raman Effect 1928). (6) NATIONAL VOTERS DAY — 25 January (ECI's foundation 1950). (7) NATIONAL POSTAL DAY — 10 October. (8) NATIONAL EDUCATION DAY — 11 November (Maulana Azad's birthday). (9) NATIONAL UNITY DAY — 31 October (Sardar Patel — 'Statue of Unity'). (10) NATIONAL TEACHERS DAY — 5 September (Dr. S. Radhakrishnan's birthday). (11) NATIONAL ENGINEERS DAY — 15 September (M. Visvesvaraya's birthday). (12) NATIONAL DOCTORS DAY — 1 July (BC Roy). (13) GANDHI JAYANTI — 2 October. (14) AMBEDKAR JAYANTI — 14 April. (15) NATIONAL FARMERS DAY — 23 December (Choudhary Charan Singh). UPSC angle: ACOR (Awareness of National Observances) is GA-essential. PYQ FREQUENCY: Vivekananda-Youth Day in UPSC, SSC 1× per cycle.

questions.stem: ROCK MEMORIAL dedicated to Vivekananda is located at:
questions.explanation: VIVEKANANDA ROCK MEMORIAL — located on a small ROCKY ISLAND off the coast of KANYAKUMARI, TAMIL NADU (the southernmost tip of mainland India). LEGEND: in DECEMBER 1892, young Vivekananda swam from mainland Kanyakumari to this island; meditated for 3 days/nights on the rock, contemplating India's spiritual + social condition. This 'COSMIC VISION' shaped his future mission. MEMORIAL CONSTRUCTION (1963-1970): EKNATH RANADE (RSS leader, founder Vivekananda Kendra) led the FUNDRAISING + construction effort. Inaugurated 2 SEPTEMBER 1970 by President V.V. Giri. STRUCTURE: combines rocks, mandapam, dhyana mandapam (meditation hall); ~7-foot statue of Vivekananda. OBSERVATIONS: clear view of where 3 oceans MEET — ARABIAN SEA, BAY OF BENGAL, INDIAN OCEAN. Small ferry takes visitors from mainland (~10 mins). NEAR: another rock has 133-foot statue of TIRUVALLUVAR (Tamil poet, 1st century BC, author of THIRUKKURAL) — built 2000. KANYAKUMARI is named after KUMARI AMMAN (Goddess Devi). FAMOUS DESTINATIONS at Kanyakumari: (1) Vivekananda Rock Memorial. (2) Tiruvalluvar Statue. (3) Bhagavathy Amman Temple. (4) Sunset point. (5) Triple-ocean confluence (Triveni Sangam — different from Allahabad's). UPSC angle: cultural-tourism + Indian heritage. PYQ FREQUENCY: Kanyakumari memorial in SSC GA, UPSC, NDA 1× per cycle.

questions.explanation: NARENDRA NATH DATTA (Narendra, 'Naren' to friends) — Vivekananda's birth name. Born 12 JANUARY 1863 in CALCUTTA into KAYASTHA family. FATHER: VISHWANATH DATTA — successful attorney at Calcutta High Court. MOTHER: BHUVANESHWARI DEVI — pious Hindu housewife. EDUCATION: Presidency College + Scottish Church College, Calcutta — BA in 1884. Studied PHILOSOPHY (Western: Hume, Spencer, Mill; Indian: Vedanta). KEY MOMENTS: (1) AS A STUDENT — questioned existence of God; visited various religious leaders without satisfaction. (2) MET RAMAKRISHNA at DAKSHINESWAR (1881-82); RK eventually convinced young Naren of God's reality + true spirituality. (3) Death of FATHER (1884) plunged family into POVERTY; Naren took up monastic vows formally after Ramakrishna's death (1886). (4) Adopted name 'VIVEKANANDA' before Chicago trip (1893): 'VIVEKA' (discrimination/wisdom) + 'ANANDA' (bliss). MONASTIC NAME suggested by Maharaja of Khetri (Rajasthan, who patronized his US trip). KEY WORKS by Vivekananda: (1) RAJA YOGA — practical yoga based on Patanjali's sutras. (2) JNANA YOGA — path of knowledge. (3) BHAKTI YOGA — devotion. (4) KARMA YOGA — selfless action. (5) Lectures published as 'Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda' (9 volumes). PYQ FREQUENCY: Naren-Vivekananda identity in UPSC, MPSC History 1× per cycle.

questions.stem: The BELUR MATH (Ramakrishna Mission HQ) is located in which state?
questions.explanation: BELUR MATH — HEADQUARTERS of RAMAKRISHNA MATH and RAMAKRISHNA MISSION; located on the WEST BANK of HOOGHLY RIVER in BELUR town, HOWRAH district, WEST BENGAL (across the river from Calcutta/Kolkata). FOUNDED: 1898; main temple completed 1938. UNIQUE ARCHITECTURE: deliberate FUSION of Hindu, Christian, Islamic + Buddhist motifs — symbolizing UNIVERSAL RELIGION concept. Designed by SWAMI VIJNANANANDA (architect-monk, RK's direct disciple). KEY STRUCTURES: (1) MAIN TEMPLE — houses SHRINE of RAMAKRISHNA. (2) Holy Mother's TEMPLE (Sarada Devi). (3) SWAMI VIVEKANANDA's TEMPLE — built on his cremation site (he was cremated here 1902). (4) BRAHMANANDA's TEMPLE. (5) Old monastery building. (6) NEW dispensary, hospital, library. SIZE: ~40 acres along river. ATTRACTIONS for visitors: meditation halls, gardens, museum, bookstore. PILGRIMAGE: lakhs visit annually; major events on Vivekananda Jayanti (12 Jan), Buddha Purnima, Christmas, Ramakrishna Jayanti, Sarada Devi Jayanti. NEAR Belur Math: DAKSHINESWAR KALI TEMPLE (across Hooghly, where Ramakrishna lived as priest) — also major pilgrimage. CONNECTION: VIVEKANANDA SETU (bridge) connects Belur to Dakshineswar (built later, 1990s). UPSC angle: cultural heritage + religious tourism. PYQ FREQUENCY: Belur Math location in UPSC PT, SSC GA 1× per 2 cycles. EXAMINER MINDSET: tests state-religious-site mapping.
